options: How to Slow Down Global Warming
questions.question:
[지문]
Then what can we do to help our little yellow friends? First, we can plant more flowers and trees. This will provide a good environment of bees to live in. Also, trees help slow down global warming. Second, the use of harmful chemicals on crops must stop. These chemicals are unhealthy for bees and people. Our little friends need our help. Let's not let them down!

위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
